thesis: Mohnish Pabrai explains that he shifted from unscripted Q&A sessions to selecting specific questions in advance to prevent boredom for both himself and his YouTube audience, noting that many repetitive questions already have answers available on his channel. He then uses the example of Lyndon B. Johnson to introduce the concept of mental models, describing them as a way to gain an advantage over others regardless of one's background or education.
